messages:
jen: noticing a spike of ECC corrected+uncorrectable on ap-sg-mlpool-*. nodes 12/24 reporting rising CE counts over last 45m, generating eviction alerts
luca: pulling logs now, can you paste the node ids?
maria: @jen saw the same on ramp yesterday around 03:10 UTC but it self-stabilized after drift reset. this one keeps climbing
jen: node ids: apsg-rack7-node12, node13, node14. dmesg shows repeated gk_error ECC on GPU0 and occasional TDR on GPU1
ben: tagging @sre-bot for capacity impact calc and to update the cluster health dashboard
sre-bot: auto: detected 3 nodes with ECC error rate > threshold, predicted capacity loss | affected_pods: 18 | estimated qps drop: 12% | suggested action: drain nodes, shift traffic to eu-west and ap-jp pools
tia: we should avoid full regional failover if possible. can we drain and live-migrate critical Dedicated jobs first?
ops-fw: plan: cordon -> drain non-prod -> drain non-dedicated prod -> evaluate remaining load -> if >10% capacity gap, shift route weights to eu-west by 20%
luca: starting drains for node12/13 now. command: ```kubectl drain apsg-rack7-node12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120```
jen: thanks. scheduling RMA for the three nodes with hw team (ticket HW-2031). ETA swap parts 8h
maria: quick ask: any autoscaler cooldowns to adjust? we don't want rapid scale-ups that blow budget, set cooldown to 600s for ap-sg temporarily
ben: noted. I'm toggling autoscaler cooldown and bumping pool burst limit +20% on fallback region to accept migrated requests
jen: rolling update: after drain of node12/13 started, node14 spiked to UCE (uncorrectable). pulling it out of rotation now to avoid silent crashes
luca: node14 cordoned, immediate pod reschedules in progress. observed increased CPU on eu-west edge; watch latency dashboards
sre-bot: alert: ap-sg average token latency increased 240ms after 15m of migration, error-rate stable. recommended continue staged shift
tia: can we limit Dedicated tenant impact? suggest we set routing policy: prefer local for Dedicated, fallback only on explicit capacity exhaustion
ops-fw: applied policy change: dedicated_preference=true, fallback_threshold=85%
ben: cost note: shifting 20% traffic to eu-west increases inter-region egress by ~3TB/day, estimate ~$1.6k/day. flagging for finance/ops
maria: ops, please create a ticket for cost approval if >$5k/day. otherwise we'll eat for incident window
jen: replacement timeline: hw swap today, post-swap stress run and memtest for 4h, then rejoin pool. target back to full capacity in 12h
luca: continued drains finished. remaining pods redistributed. I'll keep an eye on prefetch cache hit rate — we might see perf variance
ben: dropping a small config to reduce batch size for ap-sg models to keep latency SLOs during degraded capacity (batch max_tokens=512 -> 384)
tia: good call. also add canary routing for function-calls endpoints to avoid cascading failures
sre-bot: incident note appended: "ap-sg rack7 ECC surge -> 3 nodes drained -> traffic shifted to eu-west/ap-jp -> hardware RMA in progress"
jen: postmortem owner? volunteering to lead, will draft timeline and ops/rls notes
maria: assigning owners: jen (postmortem), ben (routing/cost), luca (node rejoin runbook), tia (SLO guardrails)
ops-fw: I'll update the runbook with the new fallback_threshold and dedicated_preference settings, and add a step to validate autoscaler cooldown after drains
jen: thanks all. if anything new pops, ping on this thread. :thumbsup:
